incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-12345 triggered — prod-edge 5xx-rate spike (us-east). error_rate ~12% over 3m. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/edge-5xx
pd-bot: Auto-ack window 10m; notifying SRE rotation and escalation chain.
emma: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs.
raj: joining — will check gateway pools and recent deploys.
sre-bot: recent deploy noted: front-proxy v2.7.4 rolled at 7923450000, ~30% traffic. No rollout flags set.
emma: seeing increased 502s from edge-proxy instances in us-east-1, KV-cache eviction spikes in logs. snippet:
```json
{"proxy":"edge-03","rc":502,"err":"upstream-reset","kvcache_evictions":452}
```
marta: any customer-facing impact? metrics show elevated latency for mid-tier customers.
raj: confirming — top 3 tenants show 15-20% failed requests, so yes, customer impact present.
emma: starting mitigation steps: 1) scale edge-proxy pool +20% 2) route ~10% traffic to fallback region us-west 3) warm kvcache on warm nodes. Running:
`./infra scale edge-proxy --region=us-east-1 --delta=20`
oncall-rotator: I'll take the remainder of the incident after Emma's patch. ETA ~15m for handoff.
pd-bot: PD incident PD-12345 acknowledged by emma at 7923456802
raj: quick check against backend: no DB errors, upstream model endpoints report normal latency. Likely proxy-level transient resets.
emma: confirm: scaled to +22% and rerouted 12% to us-west. 5xx rate dropping to ~4% over last 2m.
sre-bot: monitoring snapshot: https://dashboards/redwood/edge/PD-12345 — error trend 12% -> 3.8% over 8m.
marta: prepping short note for CS and Ops to summarize impact and actions, will post in #customer-impact channel.
oncall-rotator: taking over now — running sweep to remove any underperforming proxies and warm caches. tagging @prod-safety in case we need rollback.
emma: handing off: logs and runbook link pinned above. If rate rises back above 7% escalate to tier-2.
oncall-rotator: ack, will escalate if >7% for >3m. :white_check_mark: 
pd-bot: PD incident PD-12345 status updated: acknowledged -> monitoring (auto-resolve window 1h if stable).
